snippet.title: Total Reload - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Help Artificial Intelligence named HAWKING activate an incredible mechanism that can reload the Universe! Ever had something turn out so disastrously that you wished you could just reset and start all over again? In this game you may just have the chance to reboot the grandest experiment ever gone wrong. That experiment? The Universe itself.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2412090/Total_Reload/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:
